+# RC2 public delivery verification — October 29, 2026
+
+This packet verifies the actual `v2.0.0-rc.2` preview against reviewed source
+`94e02bd43d7cae1e5b6cd37ebd7a2a66a9b2b773`. Artifact availability, registry
+publication, successful installation, and consumer benefit are separate claims.
+Verification began only after the coordinator reported actual GitHub release and
+MCP registry publication. Crate publication was still in progress at that point.
+
+`verify_publication.py` reuses bounded helpers from the retained 1.0.3 publication
+verifier without editing its historical bytes. The new controlled CLI checks
+reuse its fixed extraction/read-boundary/promotion cases and add source-context
+regressions and contained output-write refusals. These are own-project synthetic
+fixtures; they do not execute arbitrary indexed repositories.
+
+The bundle phase verifies the exact tag/source, GitHub asset digests and checksum
+sidecars, MCPB manifest and embedded macOS/Linux MCP binary parity, and the exact
+MCP registry version/asset hash. It then executes the macOS ARM CLI checks and
+version-bound MCP/LSP stdio smoke from the tagged source. Linux asset and MCPB
+hash agreement is not Linux execution.
+
+The full phase additionally requires exact-version metadata for all seven public
+crates, checksum agreement, clean `.cargo_vcs_info.json` source identity, and
+byte comparisons of packaged Rust source/original manifests/READMEs against the
+tag. Fresh isolated Cargo roots and a fresh target/cache install CLI, MCP, LSP
+and the standalone alias with `--locked` and exact `=2.0.0-rc.2` selection. CLI
+and alias refusal checks and registry MCP/LSP stdio then run locally on macOS.
+No stable default, shared source, release tag, publication setting or installed
+user tool is changed.
+
+All downloads, clones, logs, installations and checkpoint receipts live beneath
+new `/tmp/dotrepo-rc2-delivery-*` roots. Failures remain receipts; retrying uses a
+new output root. Receipts preserve unresolved stages and observed workflow job
+conclusions. A source build job is not an installed public binary test, and this
+packet does not claim local Linux execution or independent consumer usefulness.
+
+The full run passed on October 29 at `05:40:06 UTC`. The retained
+[`delivery.json`](delivery.json) binds the receipt and verifier inputs;
+[`receipts/attempt-03-full-pass/receipt.json`](receipts/attempt-03-full-pass/receipt.json)

+#!/usr/bin/env -S uv run python
+"""Controlled CLI checks for the 2.0.0-rc.2 preview release; no upstream execution."""
+
+import argparse
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import tomllib
+
+parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+parser.add_argument("--bin", type=Path, required=True)
+parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
+parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+args = parser.parse_args()
+binary = args.bin.resolve()
+source = args.source.resolve()
+version = tomllib.loads((source / "Cargo.toml").read_text())["workspace"]["package"]["version"]
+assert version == "2.0.0-rc.2"
+results = []
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def invoke(repo, *extra):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        [
+            str(binary),
+            "--root",
+            str(repo),
+            "import",
+            "--mode",
+            "overlay",
+            "--source",
+            "https://github.com/example/safety-fixture",
+            *extra,
+        ],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+
+
+fixture_root = source / "crates/dotrepo-core/tests/fixtures/import"
+names = {
+    "make-diagnostic",
+    "make-comment",
+    "make-uppercase",
+    "make-prerequisite",
+    "make-expressions",
+    "just-required-argument",
+    "just-wrapper",
+    "go-compile-only",
+    "go-compile-then-runner",
+    "rake-root",
+    "rake-namespace",
+    "rake-nested-namespace",
+    "rake-mixed",
+    "rake-if-modifier",
+    "rake-unless-modifier",
+    "rake-if-block",
+    "rake-if-quoted-hash",
+    "context-repository-tests",
+    "context-component-tests",
+    "context-component-build",
+    "context-wrong-directory",
+    "context-prose-prerequisite",
+    "context-nextest-selector",
+    "command-pagedigest-manifest-path",
+    "command-uv-docker",
+}
+rows = [
+    row
+    for row in json.loads((fixture_root / "expectations.json").read_text())
+    if row["fixture"] in names
+]
+assert {row["fixture"] for row in rows} == names
+for row in rows:
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dotrepo-installed-") as tmp:
+        repo = Path(tmp)
+        shutil.copytree(fixture_root / row["fixture"], repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+        result = invoke(repo)
+        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+        record = tomllib.loads((repo / "record.toml").read_text())["repo"]
+        assert record.get("build") == row.get("repo_build"), row["fixture"]
+        assert record.get("test") == row.get("repo_test"), row["fixture"]
+
+        def without_nulls(value):
+            if isinstance(value, dict):
+                return {key: without_nulls(item) for key, item in value.items() if item is not None}
+            if isinstance(value, list):
+                return [without_nulls(item) for item in value]

+        for field in ["build_candidates", "test_candidates"]:

+for name in (
+    "readme-escape",
+    "readme-contained-link",
+    "package-escape",
+    "workflow-directory-escape",
+    "oversized-readme",
+    "directory-readme",
+    "fifo-readme",
+    "force-symlink",

+        sentinel = base / "outside"
+        sentinel.write_text("# External sentinel\n\nExternal contents must remain unchanged.\n")
+        if name.startswith("readme-"):
+            readme.unlink()
+            if name == "readme-contained-link":
+                sentinel = repo / "inside.md"
+                sentinel.write_text("# Inside\n\nContained symlinks are unsupported.\n")
+            readme.symlink_to(sentinel)
+        elif name == "package-escape":
+            sentinel.write_text('{"scripts":{"test":"vitest run"}}')
+            (repo / "package.json").symlink_to(sentinel)
+        elif name == "workflow-directory-escape":
+            (repo / ".github").mkdir()
+            folder = base / "outside-workflows"
+            folder.mkdir()
+            (folder / "test.yml").write_text(
+                "name: Test\non: [push]\njobs:\n  test:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - run: pytest -q\n"
+            )
+            (repo / ".github/workflows").symlink_to(folder)
+        elif name == "oversized-readme":
+            readme.write_bytes(b"x" * (2 * 1024 * 1024 + 1))
+        elif name == "directory-readme":
+            readme.unlink()
+            readme.mkdir()
+        elif name == "fifo-readme":
+            readme.unlink()
+            os.mkfifo(readme)
+        elif name == "force-symlink":

+        if not name.startswith("force-"):
+            assert not (repo / "record.toml").exists(), name

+                "fixture": name,
+                "result": "passed",
+                "exitCode": result.returncode,
+                "sentinelUnchanged": True,
+                "diagnostic": result.stderr,
+            }
+        )

+MANIFEST = """schema = "dotrepo/v0.1"
+[record]
+mode = "native"
+status = "draft"
+[repo]
+name = "fixture"
+description = "Fixture project"
+[compat.github]
+codeowners = "generate"
+"""

+for kind in ["generate-parent", "generate-leaf", "generate-hardlink", "ci-parent", "init-dangling"]:

+        outside = base / "outside"

+        before = digest(sentinel)

+        elif kind in ["generate-leaf", "generate-hardlink"]:

+            if kind == "generate-leaf":

+        else:

+        command = (

+            else ["init"]
+            if kind == "init-dangling"
+            else ["generate"]

+        result = subprocess.run(
+            [str(binary), "--root", str(repo), *command], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30
+        )
+        assert result.returncode == 1, (kind, result.returncode, result.stderr)
+        assert digest(sentinel) == before
+        assert not (outside / "workflows").exists()
+        assert not (outside / "missing").exists()
+        assert not (repo / "README.md").exists()
+        results.append(
+            {
+                "fixture": kind,
+                "result": "passed",
+                "exitCode": result.returncode,
+                "sentinelUnchanged": True,
+            }
+        )
+
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dotrepo-installed-promotion-") as tmp:
+    index = Path(tmp) / "index"
+    item = index / "repos/github.com/example/sentinel"
+    item.mkdir(parents=True)

+    (item / "evidence.md").write_text("sentinel evidence")

+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [str(binary), "promotion-report", "--index-root", str(index), "--apply"],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode != 0
+    assert before == {path.name: digest(path) for path in item.iterdir()}
+    results.append({"fixture": "promotion-no-write", "result": "passed"})
+
+args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+    json.dumps(
+        {

+            "binary": str(binary),

+            "results": results,
+            "limits": "Controlled local fixtures only; no upstream execution.",
+        },
+        indent=2,
+    )
+    + "\n"
+)
+print(f"{len(results)} controlled installed CLI checks passed")

+
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+VERSION = "2.0.0-rc.2"
+COMMIT = "94e02bd43d7cae1e5b6cd37ebd7a2a66a9b2b773"
+IMAGE = "sha256:114c7a4425406451c2866b6aafe69fe29b1b298832db1277d411ac73c82d04d6"
+PACKAGES = ("dotrepo-cli", "dotrepo-mcp", "dotrepo-lsp", "dotrepo")
+
+
+def stamp():
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def write(path, value):
+    with path.open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
+        stream.write("\n")
+
+
+def command(label, argv, *, data=None, timeout=60):
+    folder = HERE / "logs" / label
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    started = stamp()
+    host_env = {key: os.environ[key] for key in ("PATH", "HOME") if key in os.environ}
+    error = None
+    with (folder / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (folder / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
+        try:
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                argv,
+                input=data,
+                stdout=stdout,
+                stderr=stderr,
+                timeout=timeout,
+                check=False,
+                env=host_env,
+            )
+            code = result.returncode
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            code, error = None, "timeout"
+    receipt = {
+        "startedAt": started,
+        "endedAt": stamp(),
+        "argv": argv,
+        "exitCode": code,
+        "error": error,
+        "stdinBytes": len(data) if data else 0,
+        "stdoutSha256": digest(folder / "stdout.txt"),
+        "stderrSha256": digest(folder / "stderr.txt"),
+    }
+    write(folder / "receipt.json", receipt)
+    return code, (folder / "stdout.txt").read_bytes(), (folder / "stderr.txt").read_bytes()
+
+
+def container():
+    return json.loads((HERE / "container-handle.json").read_text())["name"]
+
+
+def execute(label, argv, *, data=None, timeout=60):
+    return command(
+        label,
+        ["docker", "exec", *(["-i"] if data is not None else []), container(), *argv],
+        data=data,
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
